name: FMC Cheltenham Spring 2025

venue.name: St Mark's Church Hall
venue.address: Church Hall, St Mark's, Cheltenham GL51 7AL
venue.details: Church hall at St Mark's CofE (not St Mark's Methodist), to the left of the main Church.

information: ## This is a FMC-only competition and is not recommended for new competitors. 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be the only WCA event held. There will be no traditional speedsolving events. Guests will be allowed but we do not recommend this event for spectators.
